The '''Pando Spur''' was an offshoot of the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]]. The minor hyperlane left [[Hollastin]], and passed through [[Xolu]] and [[Far Pando]] before terminating at [[Near Pando]] in the far reaches of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].
